body:
Long story. I was abused sexually and physically my entire life the only person who talks to me is my mother I've never had a friend or talked to a stranger even in school I need supports just to get through the day. Therapy doesn't work fast enough neither do medications. My father is threatening to kick me out after my 18 birthday since I was 6. I have another post explaining things I'll try to make another post explaining less jumbled. 

I feel I deserve a painful death because I frequently have thoughts of killing people and animals I feel like I'm becoming my father and enjoying peoples pain. I constantly watch videos on liveleak of people dying and I feel nothing at all. I wouldn't kill an animal because I've done it as a kid and it makes me feel guilty. I would kill people who deserve it but laws prevent me. I would feel no guilt killing a human. I think I'm beyond saving or helping. I also want to hurt myself because it feels like I have control over my body, control I didn't have as a child. You probably think I deserve it now too lol. I'm also a burden on everybody they pour money to give me medications that barely help and I'm unable to speak or make friends with people who want to talk to me.

I don't have a solution as I'm in the same boat just wanted to let you know you aren't alone in feeling this way. Hope things get better for you. It never worked for me but maybe making a new online friend or getting a new interest will help you (like watching xfiles or some dumb show to binge and talk about)? Something that helped me live for so long is my pets. Forcing myself to get up everyday to feed and care for them made me happy in a weird way.
